breakdown.description: The prompt mixes true and engineering measures by using the current area and current length while asking for engineering stress and engineering strain.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified using the current (deformed) cross-sectional area and current elongated length for engineering stress and strain calculations. The generated specification correctly uses the initial cross-sectional area A0 = π/4 × (12.5)² = 122.72 mm² and the initial gage length L0 = 50 mm in the denominator for strain (ε = 0.15/50), which matches the ground truth's proper engineering stress and strain definitions. The error of mixing true/current measures with engineering measures was not repeated.
